diametrically.oewn-00312450-r.label: neutral

dictatorially.oewn-00312823-r.label: negative

diplomatically.oewn-00204629-r.label: positive

direfully.oewn-00313645-r.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

disgustedly.oewn-00315374-r.label: negative

domineeringly.oewn-00323100-r.label: negative

dreadfully.oewn-00056878-r.label: negative

cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

drearily.oewn-00318128-r.label: negative

elegantly.oewn-00328994-r.tone: Restraint doing the work - the highest praise in the family, and the quietest.

eloquently.oewn-00329241-r.label: positive

eminently.oewn-00329771-r.label: positive

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

emotionlessly.oewn-00187293-r.label: negative

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

endearingly.oewn-00266729-r.label: positive

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

enduringly.oewn-00251832-r.label: positive
enduringly.oewn-00251832-r.tone: Long duration framed as strength, as though the thing had to hold out to reach it.

enigmatically.oewn-00298090-r.label: positive

enjoyably.oewn-00220590-r.label: positive
enjoyably.oewn-00220590-r.tone: Unadorned approval of something that gives pleasure, carrying none of the sense of a want answered that *gratifying* adds.

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

entertainingly.oewn-00330871-r.label: positive
entertainingly.oewn-00330871-r.tone: Light approval - it promises agreeable diversion rather than the deep hold *engrossing* claims.

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

enviably.oewn-00004306-r.tone: Praises a thing by pointing at the sourness it stirs in whoever lacks it, so the approval arrives through someone else's discontent.

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

eternally.oewn-00088030-r.label: neutral
eternally.oewn-00088030-r.tone: Solemn and absolute — it makes endlessness a property of the thing rather than a stretch of time, and still approves of nothing.

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

everlastingly.oewn-00088030-r.label: positive

evidently.oewn-00039730-r.label: neutral

family.axis: faint praise → high praise

excellently.oewn-00183802-r.label: positive

excruciatingly.oewn-00262820-r.label: negative

expensively.oewn-00335764-r.label: neutral

family.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired

expertly.oewn-00215587-r.label: positive

gamely.oewn-00348618-r.tone: Willing to try - courage as good sportsmanship rather than heroism.

genially.oewn-00221532-r.tone: Warmth that puts a room at ease.

gorgeously.oewn-00351959-r.label: positive
gorgeously.oewn-00351959-r.tone: Dazzling and enthusiastic - beauty that stops you.

gratefully.oewn-00272695-r.label: positive
gratefully.oewn-00272695-r.tone: The plain word for the feeling, with no reservation in it.

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

staggeringly.oewn-00197952-r.label: positive
staggeringly.oewn-00197952-r.tone: The overwhelm is bodily - it arrives as weight and puts you off balance, where *astonishing* works on the expectations instead.

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

starkly.oewn-00467685-r.label: negative
starkly.oewn-00467685-r.tone: Bleak in its emphasis, leaving the quality bare and unrelieved rather than merely entire as *complete* does.

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

steadfastly.oewn-00051355-r.label: positive
steadfastly.oewn-00051355-r.tone: The warmest of the unshakable four - firmness praised as something held faithfully over time.

family.axis: flat naming of dullness → slangy contempt for rigid, predictable sameness

stereotypically.oewn-00468284-r.label: negative
stereotypically.oewn-00468284-r.tone: Everyday and scornful - the thing is so easy to guess that you can see it coming.

family.axis: moralising severity → plain strictness

sternly.oewn-00242552-r.label: negative
sternly.oewn-00242552-r.tone: The face more than the rule; sternness is something the other person can see.

family.axis: contemptible → merely careful

stingily.oewn-00468873-r.label: negative
stingily.oewn-00468873-r.tone: The plain word. Its mirror image is *thrifty*, which praises the identical behaviour.

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

stirringly.oewn-00469054-r.label: positive
stirringly.oewn-00469054-r.tone: Rousing rather than tender — it makes the emotion strong and forward-moving while ruling out the discomfort *haunting* trades in.

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

stoutly.oewn-00205095-r.label: positive
stoutly.oewn-00205095-r.tone: Hearty approval - dependable in the way something sturdy is, solid enough to take weight.

family.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens

strangely.oewn-00439274-r.label: neutral
strangely.oewn-00439274-r.tone: Carries a faint edge of unease that *unusual* does not - what is strange is not merely rare but slightly off.

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

stringently.oewn-00471219-r.label: neutral
stringently.oewn-00471219-r.tone: Cool and administrative, stating how tightly the rules bind without either praising or resenting the binding.

family.axis: condemning → admiring

stubbornly.oewn-00200274-r.label: negative
stubbornly.oewn-00200274-r.tone: Refusal held past the point of reason - the word faults the persistence.

family.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

stunningly.oewn-00211285-r.label: positive
stunningly.oewn-00211285-r.tone: Commands attention by knocking it loose - the looking is involuntary, not the considered halt of *arresting*.

family.axis: cruellest → gentlest

stupidly.oewn-00176830-r.label: negative
stupidly.oewn-00176830-r.tone: The blunt, wounding word - a flat verdict on someone's mind.

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

stylishly.oewn-00471739-r.label: positive
stylishly.oewn-00471739-r.tone: Plain approval of taste itself - the elegance is credited to the person's own eye rather than to anything they have matched.

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

successfully.oewn-00120824-r.label: positive
successfully.oewn-00120824-r.tone: The family's flat statement that the outcome went well, carrying none of the swagger *boffo* brings to the same result.

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

suddenly.oewn-81484980-r.label: neutral
suddenly.oewn-81484980-r.tone: The plain member of the family, covering both arrival without warning and arrival in very little time, and passing no verdict on either.

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

superfluously.oewn-00473095-r.label: negative
superfluously.oewn-00473095-r.tone: Dismissive where *excess* stays quantitative: it says the thing could be stripped away and nothing would be lost.

family.axis: misanthropic → merely watchful

suspiciously.oewn-00242731-r.label: negative
suspiciously.oewn-00242731-r.tone: Distrust worn openly - it faults the withholding of trust, not the caution behind it.

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

sweetly.oewn-00474454-r.label: positive
sweetly.oewn-00474454-r.tone: The unadorned name for the nature the angel words put wings on - the same quality with none of the exaltation.

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

tacitly.oewn-00475152-r.label: neutral
tacitly.oewn-00475152-r.tone: Formal, and it treats the unspoken meaning as settled and binding — something one is held to, which *silent* does not insist on.

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

temptingly.oewn-00450023-r.label: positive
temptingly.oewn-00450023-r.tone: The desire it raises may be one you argue with yourself over, so the pull feels like pressure, not *enticing*'s clean invitation.

family.axis: severest → mildest

terribly.oewn-00055639-r.label: negative
terribly.oewn-00055639-r.tone: Blunt and total - among the strongest everyday condemnations.

family.axis: polite thanks → felt gratitude

thankfully.oewn-00201311-r.label: positive
thankfully.oewn-00201311-r.tone: Carries a trace of prayer - thanks owed to providence as much as to a person.

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

thriftily.oewn-00480442-r.label: positive
thriftily.oewn-00480442-r.tone: Approving outright - care with resources treated as a settled virtue, where *penny-wise* grants that same care in miniature.

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

tidily.oewn-00403093-r.label: positive
tidily.oewn-00403093-r.tone: Mild, unemphatic approval that takes in habits as well as appearance, where *clean-cut* is a verdict on looks alone.

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

tirelessly.oewn-00053027-r.label: positive
tirelessly.oewn-00053027-r.tone: Plainer than *indefatigable*, praising the sustained action itself without dressing it up.

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

torturously.oewn-00262820-r.label: negative
torturously.oewn-00262820-r.tone: The quality without the agent - pain of the order torture produces, said of the experience rather than of anyone inflicting it.

family.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

touchingly.oewn-00067005-r.label: positive
touchingly.oewn-00067005-r.tone: The mildest of the three — a small stir of feeling rather than the keen pull *poignant* exerts.

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

tranquilly.oewn-00188416-r.label: positive
tranquilly.oewn-00188416-r.tone: The stillest word here - the self-possession sounds effortless rather than exerted, unlike the braced steadiness of *composed*.

family.axis: scheming → merely clever

trickily.oewn-00295240-r.label: negative
trickily.oewn-00295240-r.tone: A warning - the skill is in deceiving you.

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

tritely.oewn-00483330-r.label: negative
tritely.oewn-00483330-r.tone: The hardest word in the family - it does not merely note the overuse, it writes the thing off as worthless for it.

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

unbearably.oewn-00486125-r.label: negative
unbearably.oewn-00486125-r.tone: Puts the weight on whoever is carrying it, so the limit reached is a person's capacity rather than the judgement *intolerable* hands down.

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

unbecomingly.oewn-00306539-r.label: negative
unbecomingly.oewn-00306539-r.tone: Measures the breach against whoever commits it - the conduct falls below what suits them, where *indecorous* faults the conduct alone.

uncivilly.oewn-00339742-r.label: negative
uncivilly.oewn-00339742-r.tone: Formal and slightly distant - the complaint of someone invoking a standard.

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

uncomfortably.oewn-00156320-r.label: neutral
uncomfortably.oewn-00156320-r.tone: The plain general word, fitting both the thing that causes discomfort and the body that feels it, which keeps it flat.

family.axis: contemptible → merely unpolished

uncouthly.oewn-00487818-r.label: negative
uncouthly.oewn-00487818-r.tone: Harsher than 'rough-cut': the missing refinement read as offensive in itself.

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

unendingly.oewn-00284287-r.label: neutral
unendingly.oewn-00284287-r.tone: Frames endlessness as the plain absence of a stop, without the grandeur *eternal* brings or the warmth of *everlasting*.

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

unequally.oewn-00334089-r.label: negative
unequally.oewn-00334089-r.tone: Carries a fault inside the measurement - poorly balanced or matched, not merely different - where *nonequivalent* only records that the quantities fail to agree.

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

unevenly.oewn-00441018-r.label: negative
unevenly.oewn-00441018-r.tone: The mildest of these - it notes variation without deciding that any part of the thing has failed.

family.axis: polite formula → wholehearted

unfeignedly.oewn-00380195-r.label: positive
unfeignedly.oewn-00380195-r.tone: Defined against pretence, which is a curious way to have to say it.

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

unfortunately.oewn-00043179-r.label: negative
unfortunately.oewn-00043179-r.tone: The mildest way to mark ill luck, registering that fortune went against someone with none of the ruin *calamitous* insists on.

family.axis: annihilating → merely unrelenting

unmercifully.oewn-00402381-r.label: negative
unmercifully.oewn-00402381-r.tone: Mercy named only as the thing withheld - slightly more formal than 'merciless'.

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

unnecessarily.oewn-00410408-r.label: negative
unnecessarily.oewn-00410408-r.tone: The family's plain verdict - it states the thing was not needed and leaves any reproach implied rather than spoken, where *gratuitous* speaks it.

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

unoriginally.oewn-00155936-r.label: negative
unoriginally.oewn-00155936-r.tone: The flat statement of the fault - nothing fresh in the thing and nothing fresh coming out of it - delivered without the scorn *trite* carries.

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

unqualifiedly.oewn-00231579-r.label: neutral
unqualifiedly.oewn-00231579-r.tone: The bare statement of the case — nothing limits or restricts the thing — with none of the insistence *categorical* puts behind it.

family.axis: a bare failed outcome → finished, with nothing left and nothing coming

unsuccessfully.oewn-00169098-r.label: neutral
unsuccessfully.oewn-00169098-r.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it records the unfavorable outcome and passes no verdict on whoever met it.

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

unsufferably.oewn-00519841-r.label: negative
unsufferably.oewn-00519841-r.tone: Says exactly what *insufferable* says, and the difference is flatness rather than degree.

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

unsymmetrically.oewn-00177264-r.label: neutral
unsymmetrically.oewn-00177264-r.tone: The plain-spoken counterpart to *anisometric* for the same condition of parts or measurements, describing the lack of match rather than complaining of it.

family.axis: chaotic → merely rumpled

untidily.oewn-00402908-r.label: negative
untidily.oewn-00402908-r.tone: The plain word, and a small complaint - it expects the state to be temporary.

family.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses

urbanely.oewn-00493348-r.label: positive
urbanely.oewn-00493348-r.tone: The formal member, putting the weight on assured ease of manner rather than the surface shine *polished* names.

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

utterly.oewn-00009459-r.label: neutral
utterly.oewn-00009459-r.tone: Flat and absolute - it allows no remainder, and unlike *arrant* it supplies no sneer of its own.

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

vacantly.oewn-00493903-r.label: negative
vacantly.oewn-00493903-r.tone: Names the emptiness as blankness rather than stupidity, the intelligence and thought simply not in evidence.

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

vacuously.oewn-00494018-r.label: negative
vacuously.oewn-00494018-r.tone: The withering member of the three: formal, and it treats the missing force as a fault rather than a fact.

family.axis: steady → heroic

valiantly.oewn-00494093-r.label: positive
valiantly.oewn-00494093-r.tone: Sounds heroic - a word at home in battle and legend.

family.axis: bare exactness → exactness pushed past its use

verily.oewn-00494943-r.label: neutral
verily.oewn-00494943-r.tone: Plain emphasis, insisting the thing is exactly the one stated and carrying no praise or blame with it.

family.axis: monstrous → merely unfeeling

viciously.oewn-00202624-r.label: negative
viciously.oewn-00202624-r.tone: Adds enjoyment to the harm - a vicious act is one the doer wanted to do.

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

vigilantly.oewn-00495238-r.label: positive
vigilantly.oewn-00495238-r.tone: Formal and dutiful: attentiveness owed rather than merely shown, with the possible danger always in the frame.

family.axis: offensive → merely audible

vociferously.oewn-00155235-r.label: negative
vociferously.oewn-00155235-r.tone: Loud to the point of offence - the outcry is itself the objection.

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

vulgarly.oewn-00461819-r.label: negative
vulgarly.oewn-00461819-r.tone: Passes judgement on the sensibility behind the indecency as much as on the act, a verdict of cheapness that *earthy* declines to pass.

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

vulnerably.oewn-00496172-r.label: neutral
vulnerably.oewn-00496172-r.tone: The flat, basic word here: it notes that an attack could land, without saying anything is missing or anyone is at fault.

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

wanly.oewn-00496422-r.label: negative
wanly.oewn-00496422-r.tone: The weak light sounds dispirited, a dimness with something melancholy in it that *pale* would only measure.

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

watchfully.oewn-00495238-r.label: positive
watchfully.oewn-00495238-r.tone: Shares *alert*'s definition but leans on the habit end of it - observation kept up rather than switched on.

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

weakly.oewn-00178969-r.label: negative
weakly.oewn-00178969-r.tone: The flat, basic word here: it names missing physical strength and stops, where sharper words add an attitude to it.

family.axis: comfortable → conspicuous

wealthily.oewn-00496653-r.label: positive
wealthily.oewn-00496653-r.tone: Substantial and settled money - more dignified than 'rich'.

family.axis: polite formula → wholehearted

wholeheartedly.oewn-00497146-r.label: positive
wholeheartedly.oewn-00497146-r.tone: Devotion offered entire - nothing held back.

family.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up

wholesomely.oewn-00497327-r.label: positive
wholesomely.oewn-00497327-r.tone: Approval that reaches past the body to character - it can be aimed at a person's morals as readily as at a meal.

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

wickedly.oewn-00145622-r.label: negative
wickedly.oewn-00145622-r.tone: The plain, unhedged moral verdict, and it covers both the settled principle and the actual practice rather than choosing between them.

family.axis: wise-looking → all-seeing

wisely.oewn-00202999-r.label: positive
wisely.oewn-00202999-r.tone: The plain word, and the one that has to be earned rather than displayed.

family.axis: prying → genuinely interested

wonderingly.oewn-00359488-r.label: positive
wonderingly.oewn-00359488-r.tone: Curiosity with the wonder still in it, and no agenda attached.

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

worryingly.oewn-00499077-r.label: negative
worryingly.oewn-00499077-r.tone: Keeps to the worry-and-anxiety end of the sense, unease rather than the hurt *distressing* names.

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

worthily.oewn-00499327-r.label: positive
worthily.oewn-00499327-r.tone: The plain baseline of the family, covering both simply having value and being honorable, without fixing what praise is owed.

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

youthfully.oewn-00499860-r.label: positive
youthfully.oewn-00499860-r.tone: Puts youth forward as a resemblance rather than a fact, so the freshness carries the whole of the claim.

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

zealously.oewn-00499976-r.label: positive
zealously.oewn-00499976-r.tone: The same active interest as *avid*, hardened into commitment - an edge that can read as admirable drive or as too much of it.
